Objectives include standardizing definitions, utilizing biomarkers and imaging, defining functional measures, developing monitoring plans, applying risk stratification models, and leveraging real-world data and patient-reported outcomes. Funded investigators will collaborate closely with FDA staff to ensure practical solutions that inform regulatory decision-making.
